topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: Adaptive beamforming with ML-based predictive modeling and hybrid beamforming architectures ensures consistent LOS connectivity. CoMP techniques and DSSS mitigate Rician fading and frequency-selective fading, while GPS synchronization enhances coherence across nodes. Doppler shift compensation via proactive beam steering maintains beam coherence.
reference_context: A2A communications face challenges from frequency-selective fading and Rician distributed fading due to high aircraft velocities.
